kind: offline package and index verification; no model sessions were run

method.package_facts: graphtyn query-intent with the frozen task request on a copy of each pinned corpus; a rubric fact counts when any of its terms appears in the serialized package
method.graph_equivalence: ASTParser.scan_directory before and after the indexing changes; SHA-256 of canonical JSON nodes and links
method.baseline_packages: Graphtyn tool results recorded in the 2026-10-25 Claude benchmark events

root_causes: validation_gate used a Rails-only pattern (perform_validations) and stayed missing in C repositories
camelCase entry points such as processCommand were not recognised as explicitly named symbols
long bodies were cut to their first 100 lines and payload trimming removed the tail with the final call
flow guidance asked to cite aliases instead of real file:line

causes: operation hints rescanned the global node list per file
caller lookup rescanned every homonym per call site
lexical mention fallback tested every symbol against every untyped file
receiver typing rebuilt and regex-scanned the file prefix per call

limitations: Package fact presence is necessary but not sufficient for answer quality; a new model run is required to measure tokens and quality after these changes. Timings are single runs on one workstation.
